text:
deploy-bot: 1778889000 - Canary deploy: monarch-finance/vpc -> dedicated-pool-42 started. Canary shard 1/10 failed health checks (5xx) within 2m. Auto-fallback triggered: marking canary failed and initiating rollback to pinned artifact af3b7e.
incident-bot: Paging oncall: severity=S2 impact=customer-specific. @oncall-sre please acknowledge.
oncall-sre: ack I'm on it — joining. putting incident channel in follow mode.
elinor: saw the alert. Monarch's canary was at 10% traffic, errors started at ~00:48 UTC, spikes to 40% 5xx for that shard.
raj: logs from canary nodes show repeated model loading OOMs in liveness probe: 
```
[2026-03-20T00:48:12Z] ERROR model_loader: failed to allocate KV cache for model x-llama-13b-v2 (quantized) - cuda out of memory
[2026-03-20T00:48:12Z] liveness_check: returning 500
```

oncall-sre: ok OOM during initialization, could be new compiled kernels or sequence length. Did this artifact change quant flags?
jules: artifact af3b7e is the pinned previous release; new rollout artifact b9d2f3 enabled int8-quant compile. Looks like the compile mismatched book-keeping for KV.
elinor: Monarch is on a dedicated VPC pool with constrained GPUs (A10x). We should revert to af3b7e ASAP and throttle any further canaries.
oncall-sre: agree. Action1: confirm rollback executed (deploy-bot already started). Action2: isolate tenant traffic if rollback sees persistent errors. Action3: notify account.
deploy-bot: rollback job started -> task id 6c9f. Reverting routing for tenant-monarch-finance to artifact af3b7e on dedicated-pool-42. ETA ~90s.
raj: while that's happening — suggest divert new incoming requests for tenant to reserved-capacity-3 (hot standby pool) to avoid 2xx->5xx flaps. Command: `routing switch --tenant monarch-finance --to reserved-capacity-3 --reason "canary fail"`
oncall-sre: good idea. Doing switch now.
(terminal) oncall-sre: $ routing switch --tenant monarch-finance --to reserved-capacity-3 --reason "canary fail"
routing: success -> traffic now at reserved-capacity-3 (100%) for tenant-monarch-finance
oncall-sre: verified 200s returning from reserved pool. Rolling rollback still in progress.
jules: deploying pinned artifact to dedicated-pool-42 completed on nodes 01-04, but health checks still failing on a couple of nodes (liveness probe timeouts). Could be node-level corruption.
elinor: recommend cordoning nodes 05-06 and reimage if they continue failing. We don't want to risk a full rollback attempt that keeps flipping.
oncall-sre: cordon nodes 05-06. Command: `node cordon pool42-node-05 pool42-node-06`
(terminal) oncall-sre: $ node cordon pool42-node-05 pool42-node-06 -> ok cordoned
raj: also increasing per-tenant rate limit to 1rps per-connection for the reserved pool, to protect against client retry storms.
maya: looped in account (FYI) — I've messaged Monarch's engineering lead saying we're reverting and routing to standby pool, minimal customer impact expected but they may see short delays. They asked for an ETA — can we give them one?
oncall-sre: current ETA: full traffic on reserved pool now, rollback completed on most nodes; final verification and uncordon estimated 12-20 minutes. Tell them 20m conservative.
jules: capture debug logs from failing nodes and attach to the rollback ticket: `/incidents attach 1778889000 /var/logs/pool42/node05/boot.log`
raj: small note — the int8-compile flag should be disabled in the build pipeline until we have a reproducer. I'll open a PR to gate int8 compile behind a runtime check for GPU capability.
elinor: also create postmortem stub and assign to raj + jules. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1778889000/postmortem

oncall-sre: handoff to night oncall in 25m. I'll stay until traffic is stable and rollback verified. If reserved pool shows errors we escalate to S1.
incident-bot: Update: incident severity remain S2. Notifying product and SRE leads.
maya: Monarch acknowledges 20m ETA and prefers we keep them updated every 10 minutes. I've set the customer expectation.
oncall-sre: will post verification note when all nodes pass health checks + perf baseline.
(20m later) oncall-sre: verification: all requests for monarch-finance are served from reserved-capacity-3, no 5xx in last 300s, rollback artifact af3b7e stable on pool42 nodes 01-04, nodes 05-06 cordoned and scheduled for reimage.
jules: opened follow-up ticket to reproduce OOM locally with int8 flags.
raj: made PR to gating pipeline: `#1234` — disables int8 compile on A10x for now.
oncall-sre: handing off to night-oncall @elinor — I'll add context in the handoff doc.
elinor: ack taking over. will watch logs for 2 hours then update channel.
incident-bot: Incident resolved for customer impact phase -> mitigation in place. Follow-up actions required.
oncall-sre: closing active paging. If anything regresses ping me directly. Thanks team :rocket:
